title: Lead netsuite sspecialist
description:
Andela exists to connect brilliance and opportunity. Since 2014, we have been dedicated to breaking down global barriers and accelerating the future of work for both technologists and organizations around the world. For technologists, Andela offers competitive long-term career opportunities with leading organizations, access to a global community of professionals, and educational opportunities with leading technology providers.
At Andela, we're deeply passionate about creating long-lasting and transformative growth opportunities for all - and doing it in an E. P. I. C. way! We're excited to continue building our remote-first team with incredible people like you. After applying for this role, you will join our Andela Community of brilliant technologists by passing a technical screening and live interview. As a community member, you'll have access to a multitude of exclusive technologist roles.
Join Andela today to access this opportunity and more in our global marketplace!
Our roles are typically filled at lightning speed, so if you're considering applying, get your application in quickly!
About the client
A global organization that acquires and scales vertical market software companies delivering mission-critical solutions in specialized industries. The company focuses on long-term growth, operational excellence, and customer success, providing acquired businesses with a permanent home where they can continue to thrive. Operating with an active mergers and acquisitions strategy, the organization creates a fast-paced environment where finance and operations teams play a crucial role in integrating new businesses and driving scalable processes. About the role
The Lead Finance Systems (Oracle Net Suite) Specialist is responsible for leading end-to-end ERP integration projects for newly acquired companies. This role focuses on migrating legacy financial systems into a centralized Oracle Net Suite environment and ensuring alignment with standardized financial processes. You will oversee discovery, configuration, migration, and post-go-live support with minimal oversight. Working closely with finance leadership and operational teams, you will ensure data integrity, compliance, and successful adoption of the new systems. This is a leadership role requiring both technical ERP expertise and strong project management skills. Responsibilities
Lead end-to-end migration projects for newly acquired companies, including legacy ERP data migration and system configuration. Conduct discovery sessions to understand current-state processes and design future-state configurations within Oracle Net Suite and connected tools. Create and manage project plans, timelines, risks, and deliverables, ensuring on-time and high-quality execution. Coordinate the migration of chart of accounts, vendors, customers, transactions, and ledger balances from legacy ERPs into Net Suite. Lead configuration and deployment of core modules within Net Suite (e.g., GL, AP, AR, Fixed Assets, Bank Recs, etc.). Standardize financial processes across acquired entities to align with group policies and reporting standards. Collaborate with accounting and finance teams to ensure business readiness for go-live and support month-end close activities post-migration. Serve as the primary point of contact for project stakeholders, including acquired company finance teams, internal technical resources, and group leadership. Present regular updates and recommendations to the group finance and senior leadership. Document system configurations, process flows, and migration procedures for knowledge transfer and audit purposes. Contribute to the refinement of deployment methodologies and onboarding playbooks to drive scalability and efficiency. Must have skills
Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, or a related field. 4+ years of experience in ERP migration, financial systems implementation, or post-merger integration. Hands-on experience with Oracle Net Suite, including system configuration and data migration. Strong understanding of finance and accounting processes, including multi-entity, intercompany, consolidation, and reporting structures. Proven ability to manage complex projects independently and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Experience with SQL (4+ years). Net Suite experience. Architectural design experience. Integration experience. Leadership experience. Strong analytical, organizational, and detail-oriented mindset. Nice to have skills
CPA designation. Experience with tools and technologies such as One World, Suite Success, Suite Cloud, ETL processes, CSV imports, data mapping, data cleansing, and integration frameworks. Experience with the implementation and integration of financial systems. Strong collaboration skills. Conditions
Remote role (100% remote). Primary timezone: UTC-4 with at least 6 hours of overlap required with U. S. time zones. Contractor role — 12-month contract, renewable. Full-time dedication (40 hours/week). BYOD (bring your own device) required. Andela is committed to nurturing a work environment where all individuals are treated with respect and dignity. This commitment applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including but not limited to hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training. Our policies expressly prohibit any form of harassment and/or discrimination, as stated above.

Vem brilhar diante das câmeras em uma empresa líder em tecnologia!
Salário competitivo + bônus por performance
Make & styling profissionais todos os dias
Estúdio moderno em SP

É você quem comanda o jogo ao vivo: apresenta, interage, distribui cartas e cria uma experiência envolvente para jogadores online.

Português nativo
Inglês intermediário (B2)
Disponibilidade para turnos flexíveis
Vontade de ser o rosto da marca e entregar entretenimento de qualidade
Habilidades de apresentação (ou vontade de aprender rapidinho!) O que oferecemos
Salário fixo competitivo
Benefícios como transporte e outros
Treinamento completo + workshops de desenvolvimento
Learning Hub com oportunidades reais de crescimento

Aparições diante das câmeras e evolução contínua das suas skills de apresentação

title: Senior backend engineer (golang)
description:
This position offers you the opportunity to join a fast-growing technology organization that is redefining productivity paradigms in the software engineering industry. Thanks to our flexible, distributed model of global operation and the high caliber of our experts, we have enjoyed triple digit growth over the past five years, creating amazing career opportunities for our people.
If you want to accelerate your career working with like-minded subject matter experts, solving interesting problems and building the products of tomorrow, this opportunity is for you.
We are seeking a Senior Backend Engineer with strong Go (Golang) expertise and hands-on experience building secure, high-throughput systems in crypto, blockchain, or financial domains.
This role sits at the intersection of distributed systems, cryptography, and regulated financial infrastructure, contributing to mission-critical platforms that process high-value transactions at scale.
The impact you'll make:
Design, implement, and maintain high-availability backend services using Go (Golang).
Build and evolve crypto-native systems, including wallets, custody services, transaction pipelines, and blockchain integrations.
Develop secure APIs and internal services that handle sensitive financial and cryptographic operations.
Collaborate with product and architecture teams to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions.
Optimize systems for performance, reliability, and fault tolerance in distributed environments.
Participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, and production incident resolution.
Ensure compliance with security, auditability, and regulatory requirements typical of financial and crypto platforms.
Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and cloud-native deployment strategies.
Act as a technical advisor within the engagement, supporting best practices and engineering excellence Technology Stack:
Go (Golang)
Blockchain What you'll bring to us:
5+ years of backend engineering experience, with a strong focus on Go.
Prior exposure to crypto, fintech, payments, or financial infrastructure is highly preferred.
Experience working in consulting, staff augmentation, or cross-team delivery models is a plus.
Ability to operate autonomously while collaborating effectively with distributed teams.
Strong communication skills in English, able to explain complex technical topics to mixed audiences.
Pragmatic problem-solver with a delivery-oriented mindset.
Comfortable working in fast-moving environments with evolving requirements.
Ability to balance client needs, technical quality, and delivery timelines.
Desirable experience with Hashing (SHA-256, Keccak), Digital signatures (ECDSA, Ed DSA), Go crypto libraries, Blockchain.
Required to be located in Sao Paulo or Rio de Janeiro. Some of the benefits you'll enjoy working with us:
The chance to work in innovative projects with leading brands, that use the latest technologies that fuel transformation.
The opportunity to be part of an amazing, multicultural community of tech experts.
A flexible and remote working environment.

title: Dental insurance posting agent
description:
If you thrive on accuracy, move with urgency, and take pride in making sure every dollar is posted correctly and every discrepancy is resolved, this role was made for you.
As a Dental Insurance Posting Agent, you'll be at the core of our revenue cycle operations. You'll ensure that every insurance payment, adjustment, and denial is posted accurately and reconciled promptly, helping protect the financial health of our organization while supporting a smooth experience for patients and providers. Every payment you apply, every discrepancy you investigate, and every balance you resolve directly impacts cash flow, reporting accuracy, and overall client satisfaction.
About i Core
i Core is a dentist-led healthcare company with more than 15 years of experience supporting dental and healthcare practices nationwide. We combine secure, cloud-based technology with hands-on practice management services to help practices run stronger clinical and administrative operations.
We are more than a software company. i Core Connect partners directly with practices to support revenue cycle management, billing, insurance verification, compliance, analytics, and day-to-day operational workflows. Our approach is built on real-world experience and a deep understanding of how practices actually function.
Behind i Core Connect is a thriving, collaborative team of clinicians, operational experts, technologists, and customer success professionals who work together to help our clients succeed. We're proud to be a leading company built by dentists, for dentists — focused on partnership, accountability, and long-term impact.
Mission: To give dental teams one connected platform that lets them focus on exceptional patient care.
Vision: Building the leading technology-enabled dental management platform through excellence in service, automation, and measurable results.
Core Values: Excellence, Accountability, Client Success, Teamwork, Innovation.
Objectives:
Review, generate, and explain patient statements, invoices, and outstanding balances
Communicate with patients via phone, email, or portal to address billing questions, payment plans, and disputes
Post patient payments accurately (credit cards, checks, EFTs) and reconcile accounts
Verify insurance payments and apply adjustments, co-pays, deductibles, and write-offs as appropriate
Collaborate with insurance billing and posting teams to ensure balances are accurate and up to date
Identify and resolve billing discrepancies or misapplied payments
Set up and monitor patient payment plans in accordance with office policies
Maintain detailed and accurate documentation in the practice management system
Ensure compliance with HIPAA and internal billing procedures
Provide professional, empathetic service to patients, including handling escalated or sensitive billing concerns Competencies:
Prior experience in dental billing, patient accounts, or dental revenue cycle management
Working knowledge of dental insurance plans, EOBs, co-insurance, deductibles, and coordination of benefits
Strong verbal and written communication skills with a customer-service mindset
High attention to detail and accuracy in financial data entry
Ability to manage high call volume and multiple accounts simultaneously
Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks effectively.
Full English proficiency
Proficiency with dental practice management software (e.g., Dentrix, Eaglesoft, Open Dental, or similar)
Ability to pass job-specific assessments Benefits:
Personal:
Be a valued leader, not just a trainer You will be recognized as a core member of our management and administrative team, with a direct impact on how our organization grows and succeeds.
Make a real difference at scale Your work supports more than 15,000 dental offices, and every agent you train helps practices run better every single day.
Work with a mission-driven team You'll collaborate with experienced professionals who care deeply about quality, structure, and doing things the right way.
100% remote – work from home Enjoy the freedom of working from home, avoiding traffic, long commutes, and unnecessary daily stress.
Better work-life balance While many companies are pushing employees back into the office, this role continues to offer a remote environment that supports focus, flexibility, and balance.
Stability and long-term growth Join a well-established organization with over 15 years in business and a clear vision for continued growth.
Professional:
Grow your training and leadership skills Strengthen your ability to train, coach, and develop high-performing teams at scale.
Work with industry leaders in dental Collaborate with experienced leaders and professionals across the dental and revenue cycle management space.
Exposure to cutting-edge dental RCM technology Learn and work with modern dental billing, revenue cycle, and automation tools used across thousands of practices.
Build and lead teams Gain the opportunity to lead training cohorts and support the development of future supervisors and managers.
Expand your industry network Meet and work with new people across the dental industry, growing your professional connections.
Develop enterprise-level experience Be part of an organization that supports over 15,000 dental offices, giving you experience at scale that stands out on your resume.
What you can expect from a career with our team!
Competitive hourly rate
Schedule: 8 hours per day between 8:00 AM and 5:00 PM EST
Commitment: Full-time, 40+ hours per week
Work Setup: Fully remote position You will have opportunities to learn new skills from our team of experienced professionals.
If you're ready to take your career to the next level and gain valuable experience, apply today!

title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
About Nature Co
Nature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.
Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.
We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.
Role and responsibilities
The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co's projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.
The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.
Primary roles and responsibilities include:
Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management
Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements
Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
Lead closure of contract signatures.
Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co's data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).
Reforestation delivery enablement
Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards
Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.
Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting
Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture
Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners. Skills and attributes
To perform successfully in this role, you will have:
A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery. Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.
Location
Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia Submission instructions
Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: English teacher with advanced portuguese skills

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.

Excellent reading comprehension skills in the target language equivalent to CEFR B2 and above.

Bachelor's degree/ diploma or equivalent educational qualification.
Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in annotation tasks, linguistic data handling, or related AI/ML projects.
Demonstrated experience working with data annotation tools and software platforms.
Strong understanding of language nuances, including grammar, style, and cultural context.
Ability to adapt quickly to changing project directions and fast-paced work environments.
Previous experience creating or annotating complex data specifically for Large Language Model (LLM) training.

Prior exposure to Generative AI technologies and principles. What We Offer:
An innovative and supportive global working environment.
Opportunities for continuous learning and growth.

you to apply!

title: Advocate art open call for illustrators
description:
Advocate Art is a leader international illustration agency, with over 30 years of experience specialising in publishing, advertising and licensing art.
We call our ethos four " F. A. C. T.s": Fairness, Ability, Creativity and Trust. It's about doing the right thing and being with the right people.

title: Railway test & validation engineer (rolling stock) – relocation to spain
description:
Boost your career in the railway sector with ALTEN Spain
Take part in innovative railway projects in Barcelona (Spain), bringing your experience in system development, validation, and testing for rolling stock.
At ALTEN, we believe that people are the true driving force behind our projects. That's why, if you have at least 3 years of experience in railway system projects—whether in Validation, Verification, Testing, or Development—we want to support your professional growth, enhance your talent, and provide an environment where you feel valued from day one.
Would you like to be part of the future of mobility? Keep reading
Your mission
Based in Spain, you will contribute to key projects by ensuring the proper validation and performance of railway systems, helping guarantee the highest standards of quality and safety.
Key responsibilities
Define, plan, and execute tests for railway systems in rolling stock
Ensure quality, safety, and compliance in validation and testing processes
Collaborate with engineering teams, external laboratories, and end clients
Manage timelines and ensure safety during testing phases
Monitor progress, results, and budget of validation and verification activities What we are looking for
Degree in Engineering (Bachelor's or Master's)
At least 3 years of experience in validation, verification, or testing of railway systems
Experience in rolling stock projects is highly valued
Advanced level of English (B2 or higher)
Teamwork skills, results-oriented mindset, and proactive attitude
Interest in relocating to Barcelona, Spain What we offer
Relocation to Spain: ALTEN will take care of all legal procedures
Join a solid, fast-growing multinational company with a strong presence in Spain
Be part of a highly qualified team in a collaborative, dynamic, and innovative environment
Access to specialized training and continuous professional development
Competitive salary based on your experience
Social benefits and a flexible compensation plan
Who we are
At ALTEN, we are more than a consultancy—we are a team driven by engineering, innovation, and talent.
We are part of a leading European multinational specializing in engineering and technology consulting, working with top-tier companies across the market.
In Spain, we have over 5,240 professionals, 9 offices, and generate more than €217 million in revenue.
At ALTEN, we are committed to diversity and equal opportunities, regardless of gender, age, abilities, or background. We believe in talent—and in the people who make it happen.
If you're ready to take the next step in your career in Spain, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Senior data scientist
description:
Temos uma oportunidade para Cientista de Dados Sênior para integrar o time da Tipspace. Buscamos um(a) profissional experiente e com paixão por games. Se você consegue transformar problemas reais em modelos robustos e mensuráveis, essa vaga é para você.
Sobre a Tipspace
A Tipspace é uma startup de games em rápido crescimento, focada em oferecer uma experiência inovadora para jogadores que desejam monetizar suas habilidades e competir em partidas valendo prêmios em dinheiro. Nosso ambiente de trabalho é leve e descontraído, com uma cultura gamer forte – todos do time são apaixonados por jogos. Ao mesmo tempo, somos muito dedicados: trabalhamos duro para fazer a empresa dar certo e entregar a melhor experiência possível aos nossos usuários.
Tecnologias do Projeto
Para conseguir navegar, é importante que você esteja confortável com as tecnologias do nosso ambiente de dados e aprendizado. Você precisará dominar:
Bancos de Dados relacionais
Ambiente Delta Lake no Databricks
SQL para consultas estruturadas
Python, com ênfase em manipulação de dados e treinamento de modelos de Machine Learning
Git para controle de versões em bases compartilhadas de código Responsabilidades
Como Cientista de Dados Sr. na Tipspace, você será responsável por:
Desenvolver modelos de machine learning/IA: entender e transformar os principais desafios da plataforma em soluções inteligentes de aprendizado de máquina e inteligência artificial.
Configurar e analisar Testes A/B: desenhar e interpretar o resultado de testes que validem os efeitos esperados, seja dos modelos propostos ou de outras intervenções.
Realizar análises de produto: explorar o modelo de negócio da plataforma para propor e analisar melhorias na interface e na experiência dos usuários.
Comunicar suas descobertas: traduzir análises e conclusões em linguagem simples e engajar o time a adotar as melhorias propostas.
Colaborar com designers, product managers, desenvolvedores e marketing para entender problemas e pensar em soluções. Participar de discussões de negócio e ajudar a elevar o nível analítico do time.
Monitorar e otimizar o desempenho dos modelos atuais, tanto na performance técnica quanto nos tempos de resposta e robustez em produção. Requisitos
Procuramos alguém com o seguinte perfil e conhecimentos:
Graduação completa, diploma com forte base matemática e estatística. Pós-graduação ou mestrado/doutorado na área de ciência de dados é um diferencial.
Conhecimentos sólidos em SQL para levantamento de dados. Experiência prévia com Databricks é um diferencial.
Conhecimento avançado de Python para manipulação de dados, usando pandas e scikit-learn para treinamento de modelos de aprendizado estatístico. Conhecimento de MLOps é um diferencial.
Experiência em análises de negócio: domínio dos conceitos fundamentais de saúde financeira de uma empresa. Capacidade de criar narrativas e visualizações que influenciem ações a serem tomadas. Experiência em startups é um diferencial.
Experiência em análise de produto: fluência com métricas de engajamento e retenção e conforto em analisar impacto de features e mudanças de jornada.
Noções básicas de ETL para entendimento do stack de dados. Experiência com DBT é um diferencial.
Boas Práticas: Código versionado com Git, familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).
Perfil Proativo: Autonomia para tomar decisões técnicas, aprender rapidamente e buscar soluções. Boa comunicação para trabalhar em um time interdisciplinar.
Cultura Gamer: Importante: ser gamer e ter paixão por jogos! Valorizamos membros do time que entendam nosso público e se identifiquem com o universo dos games, pois nossa plataforma gira em torno disso. Benefícios e Condições
Local de trabalho: 100% Remoto. Você pode trabalhar de qualquer lugar, contando que tenha boa internet e disponibilidade para colaborar com o time em horário comercial (fuso de Brasília).
Contratação: Regime PJ (Pessoa Jurídica) – contrato como prestador de serviço.
Remuneração: Faixa de R$ 15.000 a R$ 22.000 por mês, negociável conforme sua proficiência e experiência. Valorizamos talentos e estamos abertos a discutir o salário dentro desse range.
Ambiente de Trabalho: Cultura de startup com ambiente informal e descontraído. Aqui você terá liberdade para experimentar novas ideias e soluções. Apesar do clima leve, trabalhamos com muita dedicação e foco – nosso time veste a camisa para fazer a Tipspace decolar!
Desafios e Crescimento: Oportunidade de impactar diretamente um produto inovador no mercado de games. Se você tem paixão por dados e por games, vai se sentir em casa e ter a chance de crescer junto com a empresa. Se animou com a vaga? Estamos empolgados para conhecer pessoas talentosas que queiram criar algo grandioso conosco. Venha fazer parte da Tipspace e ajude-nos a transformar a forma como os gamers interagem e competem online!
Boa sorte e até breve

title: Data analyst
description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Our client is a rapidly growing Microsoft 365 and Workplace Management consultancy with offices in the UK, Asia and LATAM. They are 100% committed to fostering the growth and development of all our team members. They offer a range of professional development opportunities to support both permanent staff and contractors in advancing their skills and careers. Through training programs, mentorship, and access to industry resources, they ensure that everyone has the tools and support needed to succeed and grow within the organisation.
They are looking for someone who is versatile, with great analysis and documentation skills to work with our project teams to develop data solutions and carry out analysis for our customers. Excellent English-speaking skills and a flexible attitude are a must!
Candidates MUST be located and living in Brazil. Applications from other countries will be immediately rejected.
RESPONSIBILITIES
Analyse, clean and organize raw data from multiple sources
Model and display data with storytelling back to the business and to the programme team
Explain and present technical information to non-experts and support and coach users on technologies
Produce and maintain dashboard reports on project and data migration activity
Troubleshoot Excel related issues such as macros and linked files
Carry out ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes for related data migration projects
Create and maintain adhoc and operational reports
Troubleshoot data migration issues as and when required EXPERIENCE
Minimum 2 years working as a Data Analyst
2 years experience creating and deploying custom Power BI dashboards
Experience working on IT infrastructure projects (desirable)
Experience working with Microsoft 365 data (desirable)
Experience working in data migration projects and ETL processes
Experience developing and maintaining Management Information (MI) reports QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS
Business/B2+ Level English
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
High level of numeracy and attention to detail
Advanced Excel skills (advanced formulas, pivot tables, macros/VBA)
Strong Power BI (Power Query, M, DAX)
Microsoft Fabric
Strong analytical and documentation skills
Python Scripting skills (Pandas, Num Py, Seaborn, Matplotlib)
Power Shell scripting (desirable)
SQL skills (desirable)
Developer skills (desirable)
Microsoft Dataverse (desirable)
Microsoft Intelligent Data Platform (desirable)
Good Power Point and presentation skills
Experience working with IT systems and related projects (desirable)
Motivated self-starter
Personable and professional manner Our client actively encourages applications from individuals with disabilities and try to provide access, adjustments, equipment, or other practical support where required. They welcome applications from people with backgrounds that are traditionally underrepresented in tech and truly believe diversity is the key to creativity and innovation.

title: Advocate art open call for illustrators
description:
Advocate Art is a leader international illustration agency, with over 30 years of experience specialising in publishing, advertising and licensing art.
We call our ethos four " F. A. C. T.s": Fairness, Ability, Creativity and Trust. It's about doing the right thing and being with the right people.
We are looking for freelance illustrators to join our roster of represented artists. This is a fully remote role, enabling you to work from anywhere in the world while building your global reputation as an illustrator.
As a represented illustrator, your agent will work closely with you to secure freelance projects from top-notch clients internationally. Our clientele includes: Scholastic, Harper Collins, Hachette, Oxford University Press, Capstone, American Greetings, Hallmark Cards and Books and many more.
The best part is, we want to see your work, so there's absolutely no cost associated with your submission.
All submissions are processed by our talent scouts at ITSme, and reviewed in conjunction with our Advocate agents.
In order to submit your work, please send a collection of images or a link to your online portfolio/ website to along with some information about you. We will review this and get back to you if you are the right fit to become represented by Advocate.
To find out more about ITSme and our submission process, please visit:
Job Type: Contract
Entry Fee: NONE
How to Apply:
Send us a quick intro from you and 5-10 images of your work, or a link to your online portfolio/ website.

title: Product owner
description:
Product Owner – Client Onboarding & Customer Success
Remote (Brazil-based) | Supporting UK & US stakeholders | 8,000 - 10,000 BRL
We're proud to be partnering with an innovative, fast-growing Saa S business that is transforming how organisations deliver professional online auction experiences under their own brand. Following a period of impressive growth, our client is now looking to appoint a Product Owner – Client Onboarding & Customer Success to play a pivotal role in their next phase.
This is a unique opportunity to sit at the intersection of product, clients, and operations—owning the journey from signed deal through to successful platform adoption.
The Opportunity
As Product Owner, you'll take the lead in ensuring new clients are seamlessly onboarded and set up for success from day one. Working closely with senior leadership, engineering, and customer success, you'll help clients quickly reach their first live auction and build long-term confidence using the platform.
This is a hands-on, highly collaborative role where you'll:
Guide clients through onboarding and implementation
Translate real-world client needs into clear product requirements
Support ongoing customer success and operational excellence
Play a key role in product testing and continuous improvement What You'll Be Doing
Owning the end-to-end onboarding journey from sales handover to go-live
Acting as a trusted partner to clients, supporting early use and best practice
Gathering and defining technical and operational requirements
Collaborating with engineering to ensure smooth configuration and delivery
Testing new features and ensuring releases are client-ready
Feeding real client insight back into the product roadmap What We're Looking For
Experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or Saa S Implementation specialist
A strong track record in customer success, onboarding, or client-facing roles
Ability to translate client needs into structured product requirements
Comfortable working cross-functionally with technical and non-technical teams
Highly organised, proactive, and confident managing multiple stakeholders
Exposure to B2 B Saa S, Agile environments, or platform-based products would be highly advantageous. Why Apply?
Join a scaling, globally-focused Saa S business at an exciting stage of growth
Work directly with an experienced and passionate leadership team
Have real influence over product direction and client success
Fully remote role with international collaboration
Be instrumental in shaping how clients experience and succeed with the platform If you're a product-minded professional who thrives on solving real client problems and driving meaningful outcomes, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Staff machine learning engineer | data science
description:
Descrição da vaga
Somos uma empresa 100% digital, com tecnologia desenvolvida localmente e líder no mercado de compra e venda online. Nos tornamos a marca que melhor representa a economia circular no país.
Hoje contamos com dois escritórios nas cidades de Rio de Janeiro e São Paulo. Nosso modelo de trabalho flexível oferece autonomia e liberdade para que nossas pessoas elaborem seus padrões e rotinas com disciplina e protagonismo na conexão com negócio, as prioridades e o propósito da empresa.
Construir um ambiente diverso, inclusivo e comprometido com a equidade faz parte do nosso DNA. Entendemos que diversidade, equidade e inclusão são essenciais para criarmos um ambiente seguro com entregas inovadoras e eficientes para nossas pessoas e sociedade.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Se você gosta de aprender e quer fazer parte desse desafio, essa oportunidade é a sua chance. Nessa posição de Data Science Specialist I, você vai somar ao time Data Science que tem como objetivo construir soluções de dados para evoluir experiência do usuário e métricas de negócio de forma escalável.
No dia a dia você vai:
Construir e manter pipelines completos de treinamento, versionamento, testes e deploy de modelos de ML
Implementar práticas de MLOps para automação, monitoramento e manutenção de modelos em produção
Gerenciar ambientes, contêineres, GPUs, escalabilidade e orquestração de recursos
Atuar em parceria com Cientistas de IA para transformar experimentos em soluções produtivas
Garantir observabilidade dos modelos, monitorando drift, performance, custo, logs e métricas
Criar infraestrutura de experimentação e padronizar fluxos de desenvolvimento de IA
Suportar segurança, governança e boas práticas na gestão do ciclo de vida dos modelos E o que você precisa ter?
Experiência com pipelines de ML/MLOps, CI/CD (Github Actions) e ferramentas como Kubeflow, MLflow, Airflow, AWS Sagemaker
Conhecimento em containers (Docker), Kubernetes, APIs e Python
Vivência em ambientes Cloud (AWS, GCP ou Azure)
Forte entendimento de modelos de Machine Learning Diferenciais:
Experiência com modelagem e manipulação de dados em larga escala
Experiência com processamento e deploy de modelos em tempo real/NRT Mais sobre o Grupo OLX:
No Brasil desde 2010, o Grupo OLX tem como propósito empoderar as pessoas para que alcancem seus sonhos, reinventando o modelo de consumo. Com a aquisição do Grupo ZAP, concluída em outubro de 2020, a companhia opera a OLX, plataforma horizontal com posição de liderança nas categorias de automóveis, bens de consumo usados e imóveis; e duas plataformas líderes do mercado imobiliário, ZAP e Viva Real.
Benefícios:
Remuneração compatível com o mercado;
Plano de Saúde;
Plano Odontológico;
Previdência Privada;
Benefícios flexíveis que se adaptam às suas necessidades;
Auxílio alimentação;
Aconselhamento financeiro;
Clube de vantagens;
Auxílio Home Office;
Auxílio Mobilidade;
Auxílio Criança;
Seguro de Vida;
Licenças estendidas;
Incentivo ao esporte, qualidade de vida e bem estar;
Empréstimo consignado com taxas reduzidas.

title: Analista de sistema (pleno)
description:
ANALISTA DE SISTEMAS PLENO | CIBERIAN TECNOLOGIA
Vaga também para PCD
Há 24 anos transformando o mercado de tecnologia!
A Ciberian Tecnologia é uma das referências no setor de Tecnologia da Informação e Comunicação, especializada em fornecer soluções inovadoras que integram pessoas, processos e tecnologia. Nossa missão é impulsionar o sucesso dos nossos clientes através de soluções que promovem o desenvolvimento sustentável e o crescimento a longo prazo.
Responsabilidades:
Desenvolvimento e manutenção de sistemas;
Atuação em ambiente Cliente-Servidor;
Desenvolvimento Web com. NET (MVC, Web Services e arquitetura em 3 camadas);
Criação e manutenção de rotinas em Oracle (PL/SQL);
Correções, melhorias e evolução de sistemas. Requisitos Técnicos:
Ensino Superior completo em TI;
Conhecimento em Cliente-Servidor e Programação Orientada a Objetos;
Vasta experiência com. NET e Banco de Dados Oracle (PL/SQL). Será um diferencial ter:
Conhecimento em ferramentas como SVN, Jenkins e Redmine;
Vivência com sistemas tributários;
Experiência com Visual Basic;
Familiaridade com Gene Xus. Por que escolher a Ciberian?
Valorizamos as relações humanas e o desenvolvimento profissional;
Ambiente que incentiva a inovação e criatividade;
Projetos desafiadores com impacto real na sociedade;
Cultura colaborativa e de aprendizado contínuo;
Comprometimento com a excelência técnica. Benefícios:
Benefício flexível para alimentação/refeição (i Food);
Plano de saúde;
Assistência odontológica;
Assistência psicológica;
Parcerias educacionais;
Totalpass (benefício com academias, psicólogos e nutrição);
Avus Saúde (descontos em consultas médicas, exames e farmácias). Buscamos pessoas apaixonadas por tecnologia, que queiram fazer parte de uma empresa em constante evolução. Se você se identifica com nossa cultura e quer trabalhar em projetos desafiadores, venha fazer parte do nosso #time Ciberian!

title: Account manager
description:
LOVE startups and always dreamed of working in tech?
WANT to become a disrupter, tackling one of the world's biggest problems?
BELIEVE you can use your skills to help change the world? Oneday is a VC-backed Ed Tech company that supports aspiring entrepreneurs from all corners of society to launch their dream business, with expert support from a mentor, a deep curriculum of content, and a vibrant community of business founders.
We have raised $20 M+ in funding from the UK's and Silicon Valley's leading VCs. Our launch phase has been extremely successful and we have reached a stage to take the next step in driving further awareness and intent for our growing range of products.
We're looking for Account Managers to join our inbound sales team and own the early-stage founder experience.
What you'll do..
As an Account Manager, you'll be responsible for managing warm inbound leads from start to finish:
Conduct high-quality discovery calls with founders who've already shown interest
Understand what they're building, why it matters, and where they're stuck
Clearly position Oneday's programs and mentorship
Confidently handle objections and guide qualified founders to the next step
Book next-step calls and keep your pipeline clean and updated
Work in a high-volume environment (150–250 calls/day) while staying sharp
Track your performance and continuously improve conversion rates This is not a passive customer success role.
It's a performance-driven, ownership-heavy sales role where outcomes matter.
You'll likely do well here if you:
Have experience in sales, account management, or customer-facing roles (startup experience is a big plus)
Are comfortable on the phone and can build rapport quickly
Think in terms of numbers, conversion rates, and improvement
Can stay organised and disciplined in a fast-moving environment
Take feedback well and apply it
Have strong written and spoken English skills
Are resilient, proactive, and take ownership of results What you'll get:
Unparalleled experience of working for a hyper-growth startup
Having fun and learning from your more experienced colleagues — serial entrepreneurs, investors and engineers
Fully remote working environment
Fantastic opportunity to get to know hundreds of founders and executives in the world on a first name basis

title: Power bi developer
description:
Position: Power BI Developer
Location: Remote - Brazil or Argentina
Duration: 6+ Months
Qualifications:
• 5+ years of experience with BI solution development and Power BI Datasets, including DAX and data modeling, data mart and data warehouse architecture
• 5+ years of demonstrated experience in building and driving business adoption of OLAP Cubes using SSRS, SSAS (MDX), and Azure Analysis Services Cubes
• 5+ years of data analysis in SQL, data cleansing and processing in Python and other languages
• 15+ years of experience developing and modernizing Business Intelligence architecture, guiding development teams to best in class solutions that are scalable and performant in an Enterprise space.
• Proficient and experienced in understanding Semantic models, underlying Data lake and data models and BI DW methodologies
• Experience in highlighting the trends and relationships, causations, and other relationships through the Visualizations
• Hands on experience and familiarity with storage and compute services in Azure, Azure SQL Server, building data processing pipelines and building reports/cubes on SSRS and SSAS
• Knowledge on SQL/No SQL databases, microservices and REST APIs, docker
• Strong Knowledge on source code management, configuration management, CI/CD, security and performance.
• Ability to look ahead to identify opportunities and thrive in a culture of innovation
• Self-starter who can see the big picture, and prioritize your work to make the largest impact on the business' and customer's vision and requirements
• Experience in building, testing, and deploying code to run on Snowflake cloud data lake
• A can-do attitude in anticipating and resolving problems to help your team to achieve its goals.
• Must have experience in Agile development methods

title: Application developer - mendix
description:
Accepting CVs in English Only.
Job Level: Independent Contributor, 3 Years minimum experience
English Level: C1 (Professional)
Location: Remote, Contractor (Brazil, Colombia or Latin America countries only)
Application Developer – Mendix
The Application Developer - Mendix will work across teams to design, develop, and implement Applications leveraging Mendix low-code / no-code platform as part of the Integration and Development team within the client's Technology department. This candidate will collaborate with internal client teams and work with external consultants when needed to deliver web and mobile solutions for various client business units.
The Application Developer – Mendix will be responsible for developing and maintaining solutions built upon the Mendix platform, as well as responsible for integrating with SAP, Mulesoft and a wide variety of systems internally. This role will also be required to build processes to account for change control, governance and development of best practices for all Mendix applications built for internal and external use.
Responsibilities:
Design, code, test, and deploy software applications based on business requirements using Mendix low-code platform.
Collaborate with business analysts and stakeholders to gather and analyze requirements.
Design intuitive user interfaces and efficient back-end workflows.
Perform code reviews, debugging, and unit testing.
Maintain and improve the performance and reliability of existing applications.
Write clean, scalable, and well-documented code.
Integrate Mendix applications with external systems and APIs.
Participate in agile development cycles, including planning, sprints, and reviews.
Troubleshoot issues and provide maintenance support for existing applications.
Implement best practices for coding, security, and performance.
Write technical documentation and user guides as needed. Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
3+ years of experience in Application Development.
Mendix Rapid Certification Required
Mendix Intermediate Developer certification (Preferred).
Proficiency in Mendix microflows, nanoflows, and domain modeling.
Experience integrating REST/SOAP APIs.
Strong understanding of low-code development principles and agile methodology.
Familiarity with HTML, CSS, Java Script, or other front-end technologies.
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

This candidate will collaborate with internal client teams and work with external consultants when needed to deliver web and mobile solutions for various client business units.
The Application Developer – Mendix will be responsible for developing and maintaining solutions built upon the Mendix platform, as well as responsible for integrating with SAP, Mulesoft and a wide variety of systems internally. This role will also be required to build processes to account for change control, governance and development of best practices for all Mendix applications built for internal and external use.
Responsibilities:
Design, code, test, and deploy software applications based on business requirements using Mendix low-code platform.
Collaborate with business analysts and stakeholders to gather and analyze requirements.
Design intuitive user interfaces and efficient back-end workflows.
Perform code reviews, debugging, and unit testing.
Maintain and improve the performance and reliability of existing applications.
Write clean, scalable, and well-documented code.
Integrate Mendix applications with external systems and APIs.
Participate in agile development cycles, including planning, sprints, and reviews.
Troubleshoot issues and provide maintenance support for existing applications.
Implement best practices for coding, security, and performance.
Write technical documentation and user guides as needed. Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
3+ years of experience in Application Development.
Mendix Rapid Certification Required
Mendix Intermediate Developer certification (Preferred).
Proficiency in Mendix microflows, nanoflows, and domain modeling.
Experience integrating REST/SOAP APIs.
Strong understanding of low-code development principles and agile methodology.
Familiarity with HTML, CSS, Java Script, or other front-end technologies.
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

title: Sap basis upgrades sum and conversion specialist
description:
We are seeking skilled SAP Basis Experts to execute complex SAP system upgrades and conversions, The ideal candidate will have deep technical expertise in SAP Basis, a strong understanding of SAP architecture, and hands-on experience with SAP system conversions, upgrades, copies and migrations.
Key Responsibilities:7+ years of Basis Experience
Plan and execute SAP system upgrades (Net Weaver, EHP, SPS, Kernel) across development, quality, and production environments.
Lead SAP S/4 HANA system conversions from ECC, including pre-checks, simplification item analysis, and custom code remediation.
Utilize tools such as SUM (Software Update Manager), Maintenance Planner, DMO (Database Migration Option), and SPAM/SAINT.
Experience in Update, System copies and Client copies
Perform OS/DB migrations, Unicode conversions, and HANA database upgrades.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure compatibility and readiness for upgrades and conversions.
Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues during and post-upgrade/conversion.
Maintain comprehensive documentation of upgrade/conversion procedures and lessons learned.
Stay current with SAP's roadmap, release strategy, and best practices for upgrades and conversions.
ECS experience is added advantage

title: Staff software engineer (java/react)
description:
About the Company
Ambush is a people first company where talented, thoughtful individuals come together to build meaningful products and lasting partnerships. We believe the best work happens when people feel supported, trusted and empowered to bring their full abilities to the table.
Since 2015, because of our people first and long term mindset, we have grown into a partner relied on by some of the best companies in the world. We combine strong engineering, design and strategy with a growing strength in AI to help our clients see what is next and achieve bigger outcomes.
At the heart of everything we do is our team. We collaborate, take risks, lift each other up and take pride in doing work the right way, not settling for a quick makeshift solution. If you join Ambush, you join a group of people who want you to succeed and who show up for each other every day.
We believe in and expect real teamwork, a constant drive to be better, and delivering meaningful long term outcomes that we can be proud of together.
What we'd like to see in a candidate:
Experience designing and building backend services using Java and the Spring Boot framework, with a strong focus on scalability, reliability, and maintainability.
Experience collaborating with frontend teams and working with React-based applications, ensuring seamless integration between frontend and backend services.
Strong understanding of RESTful API design, distributed systems, and best practices for building secure and resilient backend architectures.
Demonstrated ability to design and implement high-quality, production-grade backend systems, with strong attention to application security, performance, and reliability.
Strong understanding of software quality practices, including testing strategies, code reviews, and maintainable architecture.
Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal) are essential for effective collaboration with global teams and participation in technical discussions.
Proven ability to work autonomously, take ownership of complex systems, and drive technical initiatives from design through production.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguous environments and deliver pragmatic technical solutions.
Availability to travel to Australia for an expected period of time of 2-3 months.

title: Talent manager - independent contractor
description:
Job description: Talent Manager(Independent Contractor)
**Must send resume in English**
Overview:
The Talent Manager is a critical, detail-driven role responsible for both managing relationships with our independent contractor virtual assistants and ensuring the accurate execution of ongoing administrative and operational tasks that support those relationships. This position plays a key role in Virtual Assistant retention by combining strong interpersonal skills with disciplined documentation, organization, and follow-through. Success in this role requires the ability to build trust, actively listen, and proactively resolve issues—while simultaneously maintaining precise records, managing time tracking, and supporting internal systems and processes that keep the business running smoothly.
Key Responsibilities:
Relationship Management
Conduct weekly check-in meetings with each assigned Virtual Assistant while accurately documenting discussions, action items, and follow-ups in real time.
Build and maintain professional, trust-based relationships with Virtual Assistants while encouraging open, honest dialogue.
Accurately document meeting notes, action items, and follow-ups in real time.
Keep Virtual Assistants accountable for meetings, calls, time submission, and other requests or requirements through clear tracking and follow-up.
Identify, document, and escalate potential issues or concerns to the leadership team with appropriate context and supporting notes.
Create a supportive and open communication environment with VAs, clients, and management.
Detect subtle communication cues and potential challenges, log observations, and alert management when appropriate. Administrative
Manage the full onboarding process for new Virtual Assistants, ensuring all documentation, checklists, and meetings are completed accurately and on time.
Manage the full onboarding process for new clients, ensuring all documentation, meetings, and follow-ups are completed accurately and on time.
Organize, maintain, and manage shared drives and digital files, ensuring proper document categorization, version control, and audit-ready internal documentation.
Perform basic website updates such as posting content or minor edits.
Reformat documents to ensure clarity, consistency, and professional presentation.
Compile reports, summaries, and data tracking related to VA performance, feedback, and engagement.
Maintain accurate and organized records of meetings, feedback, action items, and resolutions.
Oversee timesheet management, including tracking submissions, following up on missing or incorrect entries, and inputting approved hours into systems for payment processing Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree
Minimum 3 years of experience in HR, counseling, or relationship management
Proven ability to build quick trust and extract meaningful information
Exceptional English verbal and written communication skills
Advanced typing speed (minimum 70 WPM with high accuracy)
Proven ability to multitask (conversing while documenting) Technical Requirements:
Fully remote position
High-speed, stable internet connection
Professional-grade webcam
High-quality speakerphone or headset
Modern computer with reliable performance
Proficiency with video conferencing tools and spreadsheet software Personal Attributes:
Empathetic and active listener
Ability to create a non-threatening, supportive conversation environment
Quick thinking and adaptable communication style
Patient and persistent in building relationships
Skilled at drawing out information from reserved individuals Note: This is an independent contractor position. Candidates must provide their own equipment and manage their own taxes and benefits.

title: Web3 & al investment analyst
description:
Web3 DXB is a Dubai-based investment and research platform focused on identifying and scaling high-potential opportunities at the intersection of blockchain, artificial intelligence, and next-generation digital infrastructure. We combine deep market insight with an agile, thesis-driven approach to back transformative technologies shaping the future of finance and the internet.
As we expand our investment activities, we are looking for a highly analytical and forward-thinking Web3 & AI Investment Analyst to join our team. This is a fully remote position (Poland-based), offering direct exposure to early-stage deals, market research, and high-impact investment decisions across Web3 and AI.
This role is ideal for someone who lives at the edge of innovation — tracking narratives, identifying asymmetric opportunities, and translating complex trends into actionable investment insights. What You'll Be Doing
Conduct deep-dive research on Web3 and AI sectors, including protocols, startups, and emerging technologies.
Analyze market trends, narratives, and macro developments across crypto and AI ecosystems.
Evaluate investment opportunities, including token projects, early-stage startups, and infrastructure plays.
Build investment theses and present insights to internal stakeholders.
Monitor portfolio performance and track key metrics across projects.
Collaborate with internal teams on strategy, deal flow, and market positioning.
Stay ahead of industry developments, identifying early signals and high-potential opportunities. What We're Looking For
2–4+ years of experience in investment analysis, research, venture capital, or crypto/AI markets.
Strong understanding of blockchain, De Fi, tokenomics, and Web3 ecosystems.
Solid knowledge or strong interest in artificial intelligence and its investment landscape.
Exceptional analytical and research skills with the ability to synthesize complex information.
Experience evaluating startups, token models, or market opportunities.
Ability to think independently and form high-conviction investment views.
Fluent English with strong written communication skills.
High level of curiosity, ownership, and performance orientation. Why Join Web3 DXB
Competitive compensation: BRL 560,000 – 770,000 + performance-based bonuses.
Remote-first: Fully remote (Poland-based) with flexible working hours.
Direct investment exposure: Work on real deals and high-impact decisions.
High-growth environment: Operate at the intersection of Web3 and AI — two of the fastest-growing sectors globally.
Meritocratic culture: Your ideas and insights directly influence outcomes.
Long-term upside: Be part of a team shaping the future of decentralized and intelligent systems. If you're passionate about Web3, AI, and investing, and want to operate where innovation meets capital, we'd love to connect.

title: Immigration paralegal (portuguese speaker)
description:
Company Description
Brooks Law Firm is a trusted legal practice dedicated to serving clients in immigration, personal injury, social security disability, and workers' compensation. We are proudly committed to supporting Spanish-speaking and Brazilian Portuguese-speaking communities, and we work closely with organizations such as the Brazilian Workers Center. Our team provides expert legal guidance across a wide range of matters — including family-based green cards, deportation defense, personal injury claims, and workers' compensation — with a strong emphasis on client satisfaction, clear communication, and personalized service in multiple languages.
Role Description
We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized Family-Based Immigration Paralegal to join our team remotely. In this role, you will work closely with our attorneys to prepare and manage family-based immigration cases from start to finish. The ideal candidate is proactive, client-focused, and thrives in a fast-paced legal environment.
Key Responsibilities
Prepare and file family-based immigration petitions and applications, including forms I-130, I-485, I-765, I-131, and all related supporting documents
Collect, review, and organize client documentation to ensure completeness and accuracy
Maintain and manage case files, deadlines, and follow-ups
Communicate with clients to provide case updates, request documents, and respond to general inquiries
Assist in preparing clients for USCIS interviews, including document review and guidance
Draft cover letters, affidavits, and other supporting materials
Monitor case progress and assist in responding to Requests for Evidence (RFEs)
Coordinate with attorneys to ensure timely filings and full compliance with immigration regulations
Handle all client information with the utmost confidentiality and professionalism Qualifications
Prior experience in immigration law, specifically in family-based cases
Strong working knowledge of USCIS forms and procedures
Excellent organizational and time-management skills
Strong written and verbal communication abilities
Ability to manage multiple cases simultaneously in a fast-paced environment
Bilingual in English and Portuguese is required — Portuguese speakers only To Apply
To be considered for this position, all applications must be submitted by email to. Please include your resume and a brief description of your relevant experience.

title: On-screen host
description:
Company Description
Technicolor Studios is committed to impactful storytelling and civic co-creation by collaborating with Indigenous Nations, Black/Brown communities, Diaspora Culture, and immigrant-rooted cities. These partnerships drive narrative shaping, infrastructure innovation, and economic healing. At Technicolor, we are more than mere observers; we serve as active participants—the lens, the mic, the architects, and the ink—amplifying the voices and stories of our foundational communities.
Role Description
This is a contract hybrid role for an On-Screen Host travel targeted throughout Brasil during Q2/Q3 of 2026. In this role, the On-Screen Host will present content on screen while maintaining a compelling and energetic presence for diverse audiences. Responsibilities include preparing scripts, conducting interviews, hosting events, and engaging with viewers both in-person and online. Although this is a primarily in-office position, some remote work arrangements may be acceptable as needed.
Qualifications
Strong Communication skills to effectively present and engage with various audiences
Customer Service and interpersonal skills to build positive relationships with viewers and guests
Training and mentoring capabilities for guiding team members or facilitating sessions
Experience in Food & Beverage or Sales is a plus for hosting events or industry-related content
Comfortable working in front of the camera with a dynamic and professional on-screen presence
Proficiency in Portuguese, with additional proficiency in English being a strong advantage
Prior experience in media, entertainment, or content hosting is preferred

title: Atlassian consultant | customer facing technical expert
description:
Company Description
At Atlas Bench, we specialize in transforming teamwork through tailored solutions for Atlassian products. Our global team of experts in Dev Ops, ITSM, and agile methodologies delivers innovative services, including AI-driven integrations, managed licensing, and consulting. Trusted by over 1,000 clients, including Fortune 500 companies, we provide comprehensive support, from Jira and Confluence training to Asset Management in JSM. Join us in reshaping the future of collaboration and technology-enabled teamwork.
Role Description
This is a full-time hybrid role for an Atlassian Customer Facing Technical Expert, based in the Greater São Paulo Area with some flexibility for remote work. In this role, you will be responsible for delivering exceptional customer support, ensuring customer satisfaction, and resolving technical inquiries related to Atlassian products. You will also assist with analyzing client challenges, recommending tailored solutions, and providing training on Atlassian tools and best practices.
Qualifications
Strong Customer Support and Customer Satisfaction skills, with a focus on delivering excellent service and building client relationships
Effective Communication and Interpersonal skills for working with diverse stakeholders
Analytical Skills to assess client needs, troubleshoot issues, and recommend solutions
Experience with Atlassian tools (such as Jira, Confluence, and JSM) and a deep understanding of their applications
Ability to work collaboratively in a hybrid environment, balancing onsite and remote work
Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field is preferred
Prior experience in a customer-facing technical role and fluency in Portuguese and English are highly beneficial

title: Coordenador financeiro / contas a pagar
description:
Quem somos
A Valuement, parte do Grupo Mantu, é uma consultoria internacional especialista em Source to Pay. Atuamos com clientes globais, ajudando a aumentar a eficiência, reduzir custos e melhorar a performance em contas a pagar, gestão de fornecedores e processos financeiros internos.
O Grupo Mantu, fundado em 2007, possui mais de 12.000 profissionais em 60 países, com faturamento anual de aproximadamente 1 bilhão de euros. Com expertise em transformação empresarial, tecnologia, marketing digital e gestão de talentos, o grupo oferece soluções estratégicas e inovadoras para clientes em diversos setores e regiões do mundo.
Descrição da vaga
Buscamos um Coordenador Financeiro / Contas a Pagar para atuar diretamente com nossos clientes globais, identificando oportunidades de otimização, eficiência e melhoria de processos financeiros.
Suas responsabilidades:
Analisar e monitorar processos de contas a pagar dos clientes, identificando inconsistências, duplicidades e oportunidades de economia
Colaborar com equipes de Procurement e Financeiro dos clientes para otimização de pagamentos e contratos
Desenvolver KPIs e dashboards para acompanhamento da performance financeira
Apoiar projetos de melhoria contínua e automação de processos
Atuar como elo entre o cliente, fornecedores e stakeholders internos da Valuement Seu perfil
Experiência comprovada em contas a pagar, tesouraria ou controladoria
Domínio avançado de sistemas ERP (SAP, Totvs, Oracle, etc.)
Excel avançado (fórmulas, tabelas dinâmicas, relatórios)
Forte capacidade analítica e atenção a detalhes
Excelente comunicação para interações com clientes, fornecedores e áreas internas
Proatividade, autonomia e capacidade de influenciar stakeholders
Fluência em português; inglês é diferencial
Experiência em projetos de melhoria de processos financeiros e otimização de fluxos O que oferecemos
Uma comunidade global com mais de 110 nacionalidades
Uma cultura baseada em confiança, onde 70% dos líderes-chave começaram em cargos de entrada
Um forte sistema de aprendizado com nossa Academia interna e mais de 250 módulos de treinamento
Um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico, com encontros informais, atividades de team-building e eventos sociais
Compromisso sólido com Responsabilidade Social Corporativa (CSR), especialmente por meio do programa We Care Together Se você é um profissional entusiasmado, focado em gerar impacto e deseja se juntar a uma equipe dinâmica e em rápido crescimento, adoraríamos receber sua candidatura!

Por isso, recebemos candidaturas de todos os profissionais qualificados, independentemente de gênero, orientação sexual, raça, etnia, crenças, idade, estado civil, deficiência ou qualquer outra característica.

title: Senior analytics engineer
description:
Company Description
United Hub Digital (UHD) is a nearshore IT consulting firm helping mid and large US enterprise clients accelerate their data and technology initiatives. Headquartered in Greenville, SC, with a delivery hub in Brazil, we embed directly into client teams as a trusted execution partner across data analytics, software development, UI/UX, and project management. We hold ourselves to the same standards of accountability and delivery quality our clients expect from their own teams.
About the Role
We are looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to help one of our enterprise clients unlock the value of their data for AI-driven use cases. The goal focus for this role is to 'make the data AI-ready': well-structured, semantically rich, documented, and governed.
Your primary output is a clean, well-documented, and semantically meaningful data environment that downstream AI workloads can reason over reliably.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
What You Will Do
Semantic Modeling
Design and build semantic layers that translate raw ERP tables into business-meaningful domains (finance, procurement, supply chain, etc.)
Define and enforce naming conventions, metric definitions, and business logic in a shared, governed layer
Work with Databricks semantic layer to expose curated datasets for AI and analytics consumption Data Documentation and Context
Produce column-level documentation, data dictionaries, and business glossaries inside Unity Catalog
Establish lineage tracing from source system tables through to consumption-ready datasets
Collaborate with source systems stakeholders to capture domain knowledge and translate it into structured metadata AI Readiness
Structure data to support LLM-based and ML workloads, including RAG pipelines and structured querying
Identify and address data quality gaps that would undermine AI model reliability
Define thematic data domains and organize datasets to give AI systems the right context and scope Governance and Quality
Implement data quality rules and freshness monitors using Databricks tooling
Tag sensitive fields and support data access tier definitions within Unity Catalog
Own documentation standards and ensure the catalog remains accurate as data evolves ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Qualifications
Required
5+ years in analytics engineering, data architecture, or a closely related discipline
Hands-on Databricks expertise: Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, cluster configuration, and query optimization
Experience with semantic modeling tools, ideally dbt (dbt Core or dbt Cloud)
Strong SQL and a solid understanding of data modeling patterns (star schema, medallion architecture, etc.)
Ability to read and interpret unfamiliar data models quickly, including ERP-sourced data structures
Experience writing technical documentation that non-technical stakeholders can act on Nice to Have
Exposure to Databricks AI/BI, Genie, or Vector Search
Experience supporting ML or LLM-based downstream use cases
Background in data mesh or domain-oriented data architecture

title: Direct response ads | video editor
description:
About Hydroh:
We're one of the fastest-growing Shopify-based DTC brands in the world at the forefront of all things hydrogen water.
Our product line includes hydrogen water bottles, supplements, and accessories all designed to help people recover faster, reduce inflammation, and feel their best.
We're looking for a Performance Video Editor who deeply understands how to cut direct response ads for Meta (Facebook/Instagram), Tik Tok, and You Tube Shorts. This is NOT a branding video role we're talking scroll-stopping hooks, retention-driven pacing, and revenue-first editing.
Compensation & Perks:
Base Salary + Performance Bonus (Depending on experience and skillset)
Full-Time, 40 hours per week (Flexible Schedule just a few hours overlap with EST is fine)
Fully Remote
Resources, trainings, and courses covered we invest in our people. What We're Looking For
2+ years experience editing direct response video ads for DTC brands
Portfolio of paid ads you've edited (Meta, Tik Tok, YT Shorts — performance-focused)
Advanced skills in Adobe Premiere, After Effects, or equivalent
Strong understanding of performance editing — you know what makes a video convert
Experience editing UGC-style content, influencer videos, and testimonial formats
Ability to follow creative briefs and storyboards, but also contribute your own ideas
Comfortable with iterating quickly based on feedback and performance data
Clear communicator and proactive with timelines Bonus Points:
Experience working with health & wellness or skincare brands
Familiarity with tools like Frame.io, Slack, and Notion
Understanding of hooks, angles, and stages of awareness
Editing for long-form VSLs What you'll be doing:
Edit short-form performance videos (15–90 seconds) optimized for Meta and Tik Tok
Implement scroll-stopping hooks, fast-paced edits, dynamic subtitles, and retention overlays
Work closely with our Creative Strategist and UGC Project Manager to execute on weekly ad briefs
Repurpose UGC content, testimonials, and influencer clips into winning ad angles
Apply performance data to iterate and improve ad creatives week over week
Deliver assets fast we move quickly and expect tight turnaround when needed How to apply?
Apply directly via Linked In
Attach your resume and portfolio of previous works
We're looking to hire immediately — so if you're an editor who gets performance, we'd love to hear from you.

description:

TGA Fund is a high-ownership venture builder studio that invests in startups and creates new startups in-house.
We're looking for a Senior Software Engineering Manager to join our team! This is not a generic engineering management role. We need an engineer, first who is a hands on platform leader, reliable and decisive, with great communication skills.
This is a high-ownership role where you'll lead critical platform initiatives, scale high-performing teams, and shape the technical foundations of upcoming projects/products.
You'll get to manage multiple Saa S products via the engineering team that you'll lead. You also get revenue share from the products you'll manage via the engineering team.

Interview engineering candidates.
Code during crunch times. What You'll Bring:
(Preferred qualifications)
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Proficiency with backend service technologies (e. g. , Java, Go, Javascript), RESTful API development, and modern engineering best practices.
Experience with data systems (SQL/No SQL), messaging technologies (e. g. , Kafka), containerized environments (e. g. , Kubernetes) and UI technologies.
Familiarity with AI/ML ecosystems, including large language models, agentic AI, or AI productivity tools.
Typically 4+ years of engineering experience with at least 1 years leading multiple teams and senior level engineering talent
Solid understanding of system design, architecture principles, UI frameworks, and API driven ecosystems.
Experience building or contributing to largescale marketplace or platform products.
Strong problem solving abilities and familiarity with SDLC, CI/CD, observability, and production operations.
Ability to partner across teamsand operate effectively in dynamic or ambiguous situations.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
Commitment to fostering a healthy, inclusive team culture focused on quality, accountability, and continuous learning. If we like you, you'll be given a 90-day trial period.
Please do not forget that this is a part-time role.
Base pay during trial period: $280 USD to $500 USD per month (part-time)
Benefits:
Bonuses come from Revenue Sharing + Profit Sharing
We also give you the opportunity to bring in your own ideas. If you have a project you want to realize, and believe it can benefit from our support, then you can always ask for a vote. If your idea passes the vote, we will partner with your dream and scale it with you.
Why Us?
We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally.

Startup em constante evolução: Aqui, cada dia é uma nova oportunidade de aprender e crescer!
